taylor: Heads-up — planning a preflight dry-run for a mixed-traffic replay + soak on staging tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Goal: validate ramp profile, KV cache warmup, and canary fallback. Need owners for profiling & longtail capture. cc @alex @maria

alex: I can own profiling/KPIs. I'll instrument flamegraphs and heap samples. Which k6 script are we running?

taylor: Using replay-2026-mixed-v2.js (k6) for HTTP flows + locust for websocket/chat paths. Sam pushed updated scripts to branch perf/mixed-ramp. Link: https://github.com/redwood/perf/compare/perf/mixed-ramp

sam: Pushed. Key changes: added sticky session header and randomized user ids to avoid cache hot-spotting. Increased think_time variance. k6 command to run locally:```k6 run --vus 400 --duration 45m --out influxdb=http://influx:8086 replay-2026-mixed-v2.js```

maria: Quick Q: do we have limits for staging dedicated nodes? Last time shards hit pod OOM. Can eng-infra verify node autoscaler policy and pod mem/cpu quotas? @eng-infra

perf-bot: New soak job scheduled: id=soak-2245123456, owner=taylor, starts=2026-06-10T03:00:00Z, artifacts-> s3://redwood-perf/soak-2245123456

alex: I'll capture flamegraphs at 5m intervals and upload to /shared/perf/2245123456. Also running a short smoke profile first (5m at 50 vus) to confirm route correctness.

sam: Note: if KV cache warmup fails we fallback to cold start policy — monitor cache_hit_rate > 0.6 after 10m. Prom alert: cache_hit_rate < 0.6 for 10m => page on-call.

taylor: Can someone volunteer to watch #rollouts during the run? Need ack for alerts and to consider rollback if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.

maria: :hand: I can watch the first 30m and triage. Also QA: please run the small synthetic checklists (top-5 routes) and DM results.

alex: Small repro note: to reproduce the earlier pod OOM add a quick spike step `--vus 1500` for 2m. Avoid in main run unless we isolate worker pools.

sam: If you want to dry-run the locust master/workers:
```
# master
locust -f locust_chat.py --master --expect-workers=4 --host=https://staging.redwood.ai
# worker(s)
locust -f locust_chat.py --worker --master-host=MASTER_IP
```

taylor: Action items: alex profiling owner, maria monitoring owner, sam scripts/runner owner. I'll own infra handoff and the postmortem. Creating checklist in runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/soak-preflight-2026

maria: One more — add note to not flip any production feature flags. Use OPTIMIZE=false env in scripts to be safe.

alex: ACK. Uploading initial heap snapshots now to /shared/perf/2245123456/snapshots

perf-bot: Soak run started: id=soak-2245123456, phase=ramp, target_vus=400, timestamp=2245123600

taylor: Thanks all — please update this thread with any blockers or infra confirmations.
